nextrain.page.title: Nextrain - Dovecot Studio
nextrain.intro.name: Nextrain
nextrain.intro.description: is your next Minecraft railway mod.
nextrain.features.engine.title: A new engine
nextrain.features.engine.description: Nextrain makes assembling trains and laying track simpler and more convenient than existing Minecraft railway mods.
nextrain.features.controls.title: Realistic controls
nextrain.features.controls.description: Inspired by well-known railway simulators, Nextrain includes many moving, interactive parts for a realistic driving experience in single-player and multiplayer worlds.
nextrain.features.style.title: An immersive style
nextrain.features.style.description: Official Nextrain train packs use a low-poly style that preserves more controls from real trains, fits naturally into Minecraft, and uses fewer system resources.
nextrain.features.style.performance: Frame rates stay high even when several long trains are nearby.
nextrain.features.integration.title: Seamless integration
nextrain.features.integration.name: Metropolis
nextrain.features.integration.descriptio: is gradually moving away from its MTR dependency to become a multiplatform railway decoration mod. Nextrain and Metropolis will focus on railway engines and station management respectively.
